verdict.rationale: Omnara is a managed-agent platform, so turning a design into a working implementation is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never documents a mockup- or design-to-code workflow. The ability to attach images to a conversation and generic agent configs are adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can go from a mockup or design to a working implementation without an engineering handoff
